title: Medication
description: Scheduled doses in InfluxDB BodyStats (medication), from every source that writes them: what was taken, missed or skipped, per medication and per dose.

list.name: tz
list.label: Time zone
list.description: IANA time zone the days and weeks are cut in (TRIBUTARY_TZ).

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "medication" WITH KEY = "user"
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "medication" WITH KEY = "user"

list.name: source
list.label: Source
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "medication" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "medication" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: med
list.label: Medication
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "medication" WITH KEY = "med" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "medication" WITH KEY = "med" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/

list.name: nights
list.label: Night sources
list.description: Every source of nights in SleepStats, for the sleep and heart pickers.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sleep_session" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sleep_session" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: sleep_from
list.label: Sleep from
list.description: The source of the time asleep, the stages and the bedtimes.

list.name: score_from
list.label: Sleep score from
list.description: The source of the sleep score. Each device scores on its own scale.

list.name: rhr_from
list.label: Resting HR from
list.description: The source of the resting heart rate.

panels.title: Doses taken

targets.query: SELECT sum("taken") AS "Doses taken" FROM "medication" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "med" =~ /^${med:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Doses logged as taken in the range.

panels.title: Logged as taken

targets.query: SELECT mean("taken") AS "Logged as taken" FROM "medication" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "med" =~ /^${med:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Share of scheduled doses logged as taken. A dose never answered in the app (unlogged) counts as not taken.

panels.title: Missed or skipped

targets.query: SELECT count("taken") AS "Missed or skipped" FROM "medication" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "med" =~ /^${med:regex}$/ AND ("status" = 'missed' OR "status" = 'skipped') AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Doses the app marked missed, or that were skipped (the reason, if any, is in the dose table).

panels.title: Days with a dose taken

targets.query: SELECT count("t") AS "Days with a dose taken" FROM (SELECT max("taken") AS "t" FROM "medication" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "med" =~ /^${med:regex}$/ AND "taken" = 1 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')) WHERE $timeFilter

panels.description: Days with at least one dose of the selected medications logged as taken.

panels.title: Every medication: share of scheduled doses logged as taken

targets.query: SELECT mean("taken") FROM "medication" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "med" =~ /^${med:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "med" fill(null)

panels.description: One row per medication. Colour = share of the doses scheduled in each bucket logged as taken; blank = nothing scheduled. Zoom in for one bucket per day.

panels.title: Per medication

targets.query: SELECT count("taken") AS "Scheduled", sum("taken") AS "Taken", mean("taken") AS "Taken %" FROM "medication" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "med" =~ /^${med:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "med"
SELECT first("taken") AS "f" FROM "medication" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "med" =~ /^${med:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "med"
SELECT last("taken") AS "l" FROM "medication" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "med" =~ /^${med:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "med"
SELECT last("dose") AS "Dose" FROM "medication" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "med" =~ /^${med:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "med"
SELECT last("unit") AS "Unit" FROM "medication" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "med" =~ /^${med:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "med"
SELECT last("strength") AS "Strength" FROM "medication" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "med" =~ /^${med:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "med"

panels.description: Within the range: first and last scheduled dose, doses scheduled and taken, and the dose of the latest entry.

panels.title: A medication and the nights (set the range to start on the day it changed)

options.content: Set the time range to start on the day a medication began, stopped or changed dose, for as long after as you want to judge. **The tiles compare the nights in the range with the same length of time just before it**, from the source picked in *Sleep from*, *Sleep score from* and *Resting HR from*. The strip above shows when each medication was taken; the 30-night averages below draw every source, a line per device: compare a line with itself, never across colours. Another change in the same months (a second medication, a new device) weighs on the same nights.

panels.title: Nights compared
panels.description: Nights the picked source recorded before the range and during it. Few nights make a weak comparison. Before: the same length of time just before the range.

targets.query: SELECT count("sleepTimeSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT count("sleepTimeSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT count("asleep_s") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT count("asleep_s") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Time asleep
panels.description: Mean time asleep per night. Before: the same length of time just before the range.

targets.query: SELECT mean("sleepTimeSeconds") / 3600 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT mean("sleepTimeSeconds") / 3600 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter

SELECT mean("asleep_s") / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT mean("asleep_s") / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Awake per night
panels.description: Mean time awake inside the night, by the source's own definition. Before: the same length of time just before the range.

targets.query: SELECT mean("awakeSleepSeconds") / 60 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT mean("awakeSleepSeconds") / 60 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT mean("awake_s") / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT mean("awake_s") / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Awakenings per night
panels.description: Mean number of awakenings. Sources count them differently (a strap counts every disturbance): compare a source with itself. Before: the same length of time just before the range.

targets.query: SELECT mean("awakeCount") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT mean("awakeCount") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT mean("awakenings") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT mean("awakenings") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Mean deep (slow-wave) sleep. Before: the same length of time just before the range.

targets.query: SELECT mean("deepSleepSeconds") / 60 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT mean("deepSleepSeconds") / 60 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT mean("deep_s") / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT mean("deep_s") / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter

targets.query: SELECT mean("remSleepSeconds") / 60 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms

targets.query: SELECT mean("sleepScore") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${score_from}' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT mean("sleepScore") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${score_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT mean("score") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${score_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT mean("score") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${score_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter

targets.query: SELECT mean("restingHeartRate") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${rhr_from}' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms
SELECT mean("restingHeartRate") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${rhr_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT mean("resting_hr") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${rhr_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - (${__to}ms - ${__from}ms) AND time < ${__from}ms

panels.title: Time awake per night (30-night average)
panels.description: Each source counts it its own way (a strap counts every awake minute in bed), so the lines sit apart: compare a line with itself. A night's value is averaged with the 29 before it.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(mean("awakeSleepSeconds"), 30) / 60 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND time >= ${__from}ms - 60d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("awake_s"), 30) / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 60d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Awakenings per night (30-night average)
panels.description: Each source counts them its own way (a strap counts every disturbance): compare a line with itself. A night's value is averaged with the 29 before it.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(mean("awakeCount"), 30) FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND time >= ${__from}ms - 60d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("awakenings"), 30) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 60d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Deep sleep per night (30-night average)
panels.description: Deep (slow-wave) sleep, one line per source. A night's value is averaged with the 29 before it.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(mean("deepSleepSeconds"), 30) / 60 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND time >= ${__from}ms - 60d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("deep_s"), 30) / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 60d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Sleep score (30-night average, each source's own scale)
panels.description: Each device scores on its own scale: compare a line with itself. A night's value is averaged with the 29 before it.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(mean("sleepScore"), 30) FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND time >= ${__from}ms - 60d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("score"), 30) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 60d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Every dose
Every dose

targets.query: SELECT "med" AS "Medication", "status" AS "Status", "dose" AS "Dose", "unit" AS "Unit", "strength" AS "Strength", "delay_min" AS "Delay", "note" AS "Note", "source" AS "Source" FROM "medication" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "med" =~ /^${med:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 5000

panels.description: Time = scheduled time. Status: taken, missed (the app marked it), skipped (dismissed, reason in Note), unlogged (never answered). Delay = minutes between the schedule and marking it taken.
